dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward a sharply defined posterior apex.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and continuous with no visible localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with subtle light-grey shading on the lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; shading gradients are soft across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single dark-grey longitudinal linear mark is visible on the posterior dorsal axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A subtle longitudinal indentation is visible along the dorsal ridge, creating a low-contrast shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct longitudinal linear mark or scar is present on the posterior dorsal ridge.
